meta.name: feedback
meta.description: Assess a field lesson for reuse or product feedback without exposing customer context. Use for recurring deployment lessons; distinguish a hypothesis from a validated pattern.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把现场教训整理成可复用的做法或产品反馈,同时隐去客户信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果团队反复踩同类部署坑,却难把现场经验沉淀成可复用做法。
copy.tagline_en: Turn field lessons into reusable patterns or product feedback.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team keeps hitting the same field issues and struggles to capture lessons.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会评估一条现场经验:判断它适合复用作模式,还是应提交为产品反馈,并且不暴露客户上下文。产出的结论会区分「假设」与「已验证的模式」。
howto.when: 当你拿来反复出现的部署经验/教训需要评估时触发;若由 @fde 调用,直接沿用它当前已脱敏的包与范围,不重新做设置、发现或已答过的提问。

say.text: 评估这条部署经验:该复用,还是提产品反馈?
say.note: 会区分假设与已验证模式

say.text: 由 @fde 接着处理,沿用现有脱敏包和范围
报告里把未知项留出来,实现、验证、部署、验收分开写

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude assesses one field lesson to decide whether it can be reused or should become product feedback, without exposing customer context. Its output separates a hypothesis from a validated pattern.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you bring a recurring deployment lesson for assessment. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup, discovery or answered questions.

say_en.text: Assess this field lesson: reuse it, or send it as product feedback?
Have @fde take this over using the current sanitized packet
say_en.note: No restart of setup or questions

say_en.text: Keep unknowns in the report; split implementation, verification, deployment, acceptance
